ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) central pigmentation relative to 40% high-intensity (white) lateral pigmentation across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black central wedge extending from the median notch toward the leading edge; white pigmentation dominant on the distal regions of both lobes, with the left lobe possessing a larger contiguous white area compared to the right lobe's fragmented white-to-black transition.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetric V-shaped indentation with a sharp vertex angle approximately 50 degrees from the longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Consistent irregular micro-serrations with pixel-level amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) forming a jagged trailing edge silhouette against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering significantly toward acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-intensity white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel linear streaks (rake marks) cutting diagonally across the white pigmentation of the left lobe and sporadically on the outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks on the ventral surface of both lobes; calcified scarring or barnacle colonization at the lobe tips.
